slides.texte_overlay:
Habits that make a man
sharper every single year

1. Write down one thing
you learned each night

One line. 365 a year.

2. Train your body

A strong body carries
a clear head.

3. Teach what you learn

Explaining it to a friend
locks it in.

4. Pick one new skill a year

Cooking, a language, chess.
Ten years, ten skills.

5. Walk without headphones

Your best ideas need
a little quiet.

6. Learn something daily

Five minutes.
Every single day.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. Learn something daily

I do 5 minutes a day
on the Sophia app.
Every single day.
